steps.input:
centers={(3,6):8,(4,13):4,(12,14):1,(14,3):2}
blank=(10,8)
# explicit marker coordinates (all arms)
obj_arms={c:{(c[0]-1,c[1]),(c[0]+1,c[1]),(c[0],c[1]-1),(c[0],c[1]+1)} for c in centers}
blank_arms={(9,8),(11,8),(10,7),(10,9)}
all_arms=set().union(*obj_arms.values(),blank_arms)
# Grid fill by directional rays; each ray proceeds through own arms, stops on a foreign arm.
hits_h={}; hits_v={}
for center,color in centers.items():
    r,c=center
    for dc in (-1,1):
        j=c+dc
        while 0<=j<19:
            pos=(r,j)
            if pos in all_arms and pos not in obj_arms[center]: break
            if j != blank[1] and pos not in all_arms: hits_h[pos]=color
            j+=dc
    for dr in (-1,1):
        i=r+dr
        while 0<=i<19:
            pos=(i,c)
            if pos in all_arms and pos not in obj_arms[center]: break
            if pos not in all_arms: hits_v[pos]=color
            i+=dr
# center cells
for pos,color in centers.items(): hits_h[pos]=color
# compose vertical over horizontal, then all marker arms 3 override.
g2=[[0]*19 for _ in range(19)]
for (r,c),v in hits_h.items():g2[r][c]=v
for (r,c),v in hits_v.items():g2[r][c]=v
for r,c in all_arms:g2[r][c]=3
print('\n'.join(str(x) for x in g2))
print('h rays',len(hits_h),'v rays',len(hits_v))
